Monument_Completed: HEARTS CAN NOW BE COLLECTED INSTANTLY!
Monument3_Completed: SPIRIT INCREASED BY ONE HUNDRED! CONGRATS!
Monument4_Completed: UTOPIUM HARVEST LIMIT DOUBLED IN THAW SEASON! CONGRATS!
MonumentPart1_Desc: We've stumbled upon something particularly fascinating, old chap. It looks like we're going to have to sink in a lot of time and money to figure out what it is!
MonumentPart2_Desc: Though we've got our best clones on the job, we can't quite tell what's going on in here. Progress is slow, but steady.
MonumentPart3_Desc: The design is puzzling. It's unlike anything we've seen before. An ancient facade seems to be taking shape.
MonumentPart4_Desc: This is turning out to be quite the adventure. They should turn this expedition into a movie some day. Or maybe even a game.
MonumentPart5_Desc: We're going to need more money, old chap. We may just have chanced upon something incredible. Something invaluable. Something that might change... everything.
MonumentPart6_Desc: Something has been kept secret in the hollows of this structure, for a long, long time.
MonumentPart7_Desc: What if this is just a wild goose chase? What if it's all a distraction from the bigger questions? As the team grows, it team grows restless.
MonumentPart8_Desc: This is it. We're almost there. We must not lose focus. We must not lose hope. And above all else, we must not lose love.
MonumentPart9_Desc: A new rediscovery has been made! It appears that hearts never need to be pumped at all. Try it out yourself, old chap. I'm not sure what to make of it myself.
Monument3Part1_Desc: A new riddle from ancient times. I tell you old chap, it's like there's an entire planet's worth of artefacts floating about in the space around us.
Monument3Part2_Desc: This mystery is barely skin deep! It seems like we're already at the bottom of it. Or are we? Could this be the fabled underwater base from Earth?
Monument3Part3_Desc: Look at this charming fellow in the Mech Bay. He looks like some kind of medical assistant. What operations were they performing here?
Monument3Part4_Desc: A short puzzle, but fulfilling nonetheless. This face will lift our spirits to new heights. Go on, bask in the glory and enjoy the extra spirit!
Monument4Part1_Desc: I believe it was Mothership's will that we should come back, so that men might know the things that are in the world... - Mako Polo
Monument4Part2_Desc: Some mayors give up their designs when they have almost reached the goal; While others, on the contrary, obtain a Utopia by exerting, at the last moment, more vigorous efforts than ever before. - Herobotus
Monument4Part3_Desc: I propose to construct a new chart for navigating, on which I shall delineate all the sea and lands of the cosmos in their proper positions...  to put down all as it were in a picture... - Chrystofer Cumulus
Monument4Part4_Desc: No borders, just horizons - only endless space.. - Emilia Earheart
Monument2Part1_Desc: My goodness, Old Chap! We've struck something again. I reckon it's going to be another long road ahead, but I have a feeling it will be worth it.
Monument2Part2_Desc: Are you sure that this will pay off? It seems like quite a gamble. At this point we can't even tell for sure what we're staring at.
Monument2Part3_Desc: This style of construction is most peculiar. We can't quite tell head or tail of it as yet. But we soldier on, growing older and stronger.
Monument2Part4_Desc: Aha! The structure finally begins to take shape. Or so we think. Is this a modern colisseum of sorts? Did gladiators battle within the confines of these walls?
Monument2Part5_Desc: What's this? The monument seems to have been built to protect and contain some kind of... turf. Was this a museum for the precious material known as grass?
Monument2Part6_Desc: More infrastructure for spectators. What could be so fascinating about watching grass grow?
Monument2Part7_Desc: Our secondary unit is investigating the subterranean levels of the monument in hopes of finding more clues to this mysterious edifice.
Monument2Part8_Desc: The fabled earth cup! This was the venue for the greatest athletic warriors of our world. It looks like it's time again for a celebration of sport!
Monument2Part9_Desc: What can I say. We were expecting another miracle at the end of this excavation. But it looks like we'll just have to settle for a magnificent playground instead.

Hotel_NewsFeed: Hotel to consider actually offering rooms to Utopians, after incessant demands from residents wanting to renovate their homes.
MissionControl_NewsFeed: Most Utopians feel ambivalent about the presence of new members from Utopia HQ in town. Rise in animal disappearances however may be a long-term cause for concern. Utopia Corp. ensures that there is nothing to worry about.
MissionControl_BuildPreview: Because we're on a mission here.
Hotel_MoreDesc: When Utopians need a swish staycay, Hotel Utopia is their top choice. A VACATION removes clones from their residence and workplace. To check them out, have a vacant residence space for them.
MissionControl_MoreDesc: Utopia Corp's mission control was set up to closely monitor the stranger discoveries being made in towns. Samples are periodically collected and beamed up, to fuel cutting edge research at the Mothership. Architects designed the building to consist of 4 towers, each representing one core value of the Corporation. NOTE: Mayors are warned that all animals, utopium, and coins committed to missions will be permanently taken away in exchange for rewards. Some rewards can be bought out using Utopium.
